description.value: A small-batch craft distillery in Tofino's industrial area, handcrafting certified organic spirits from BC grain and Meares Island watershed water. The tasting room offers mini-cocktail samplers from a rotating lineup that includes gin, vodka, absinthe, whiskey, and limoncello, plus grab-and-go kombucha and craft tonics.

address.value: 681 Industrial Way, Unit G & H, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Tofino Distillery is an active craft distillery with a tasting room at 681 Industrial Way, Tofino. Phone (250) 725-2182 and email info@tofinocraftdistillery.com are listed on the site. The website mentions 'Craft Tonics and Tofino Kombucha To Go' suggesting takeout beverages, but no mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, or any cycling-related amenities.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft distillery with a walk-in tasting room in Tofino, a key destination on the Pacific Rim cycling corridor. A worthwhile stop for touring cyclists looking for a local tasting experience.
